lines.text: 봄이 왔어요. 할아버지가 텃밭에 구멍을 팠어요.
lines.en: Spring came. Grandpa dug a hole in the garden.
segs: Spring came. Grandpa dug a hole in the garden.

lines.text: "순무야, 크게 자라라." 씨앗을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: "Turnip, grow big and strong." Tap the seed!
Tap the seed!
The seed slipped right into the soil.
segs: The seed slipped right into the soil.

lines.text: 파란 싹이 났어요! 톡톡 눌러서 물도 주고 햇볕도 줘요.
lines.en: A green sprout popped up! Tap, tap to give it water and sunshine.
segs: A green sprout popped up! Tap, tap to give it water and sunshine.

lines.en: Tap, tap the turnip sprout!

lines.text: 여름이 되었어요. 순무 잎이 할아버지 키만큼 자랐어요!
lines.en: Summer came. The turnip leaves grew as tall as Grandpa!
segs: Summer came. The turnip leaves grew as tall as Grandpa!

lines.text: 할아버지가 순무 잎을 꽉 잡았어요. 톡톡 눌러서 영차!
lines.en: Grandpa grabbed the turnip leaves tight. Tap, tap and heave-ho!
segs: Grandpa grabbed the turnip leaves tight. Tap, tap and heave-ho!

lines.en: Tap, tap Grandpa to heave-ho, heave-ho!
segs: Tap, tap Grandpa to heave-ho, heave-ho!

lines.en: The turnip won't budge.

lines.text: 혼자서는 안 되겠어요. 할아버지를 톡 눌러서 할머니를 불러요!
lines.en: Grandpa can't do it alone. Tap Grandpa to call Grandma!
segs: Grandpa can't do it alone. Tap Grandpa to call Grandma!

lines.en: Tap Grandpa! Call Grandma.
Oof! Grandpa plopped down on the ground.
segs: Grandpa plopped down on the ground.

lines.en: Grandma came running. "Let's do it together!"

lines.text: 할머니가 할아버지 허리를 잡고, 톡톡톡 영차!
lines.en: Grandma held on to Grandpa's waist. Tap, tap, tap, heave-ho!
segs: Grandma held on to Grandpa's waist. Tap, tap, tap, heave-ho!

lines.en: Tap, tap the turnip and heave-ho!
segs: Tap, tap the turnip and heave-ho!

lines.text: 순무가 한 뼘 올라왔어요! 그래도 안 뽑혀요.
lines.en: The turnip came up a little! But it still won't come out.
segs: The turnip came up a little! But it still won't come out.

lines.en: Who will Grandma call?

lines.text: 음매~ 소는 풀을 먹고 있대요. 사람 친구를 먼저 불러요!
lines.en: Moo~ The cow is busy eating grass. Let's call a people friend first!
segs: Moo~ The cow is busy eating grass. Let's call a people friend first!

lines.en: It's the granddaughter! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's the granddaughter! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: "Sweetie~!" The granddaughter held Grandma's waist. Heave-ho!
segs: The granddaughter held Grandma's waist. Heave-ho!

lines.text: 조금 더 올라왔어요! 누가 더 도와줄까요?
lines.en: It came up a little more! Who will help next?
segs: It came up a little more! Who will help next?

lines.en: Woof woof from behind the bush! Who could it be?
segs: Woof woof from behind the bush! Who could it be?

lines.text: 멍멍 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
lines.en: Who goes woof woof? Listen again.
segs: Who goes woof woof? Listen again.

lines.en: It's the puppy! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's the puppy! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: The puppy came bounding out. "I'll help too!"

lines.text: 강아지가 손녀 치마를 꼭 붙잡았어요. 영차!
lines.en: The puppy held the granddaughter's skirt tight. Heave-ho!
segs: The puppy held the granddaughter's skirt tight. Heave-ho!

lines.en: Meow from the barn roof! Who could it be?
segs: Meow from the barn roof! Who could it be?

lines.text: 야옹 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
lines.en: Who goes meow? Listen again.
It's the cat! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's the cat! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: The cat hopped down from the roof.
segs: The cat hopped down from the roof.

lines.en: Huh? The puppy and the cat are glaring at each other.
segs: Huh? The puppy and the cat are glaring at each other.

lines.text: "흥!" 그래도 고양이가 강아지 꼬리를 꼭 잡았어요.
lines.en: "Hmph!" But the cat held the puppy's tail tight anyway.
segs: But the cat held the puppy's tail tight anyway.

lines.en: Phew, everyone got tired and plopped down.
segs: Phew, everyone got tired and plopped down.

lines.text: 흙구멍에서 찍찍 소리가 나요. 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Squeak, squeak from a hole in the ground. Tap it!
segs: Squeak, squeak from a hole in the ground. Tap it!

lines.en: Tap the mouse in the hole!
segs: Tap the mouse in the hole!

lines.en: A teeny tiny mouse scurried out.
segs: A teeny tiny mouse scurried out.

lines.en: "You're too small. It won't work~"
segs: You're too small. It won't work~

lines.text: "나도 할래요!" 생쥐가 고양이 꼬리를 꼭 잡았어요.
lines.en: "Me too!" The mouse held the cat's tail tight.
segs: The mouse held the cat's tail tight.

lines.text: 이번엔 여섯이 다 함께! 순무를 꾹 눌러요. 영~차!
lines.en: This time, all six together! Press and hold the turnip. Heave-ho!
segs: This time, all six together! Press and hold the turnip. Heave-ho!

lines.en: Keep pressing the turnip. Heave-ho!

lines.text: 쑥! 커다란 순무가 뽑혔어요! 모두 벌렁 넘어졌어요.
lines.en: Pop! The big turnip came out! Everyone tumbled over backwards.
segs: Pop! The big turnip came out! Everyone tumbled over backwards.

lines.text: 작은 생쥐까지 모두 힘을 모았더니 뽑혔어요!
lines.en: When everyone, even the tiny mouse, pulled together, it came out!
segs: When everyone, even the tiny mouse, pulled together, it came out!

lines.en: They cooked yummy turnip soup.

lines.text: 누가 먼저 순무를 잡았지? 차례대로 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Who grabbed the turnip first? Tap them in order!
segs: Who grabbed the turnip first? Tap them in order!

lines.en: Who was first?
Who grabbed on after Grandpa?
Who grabbed on after Grandma?
Who grabbed on after the granddaughter?
segs: Who grabbed on after the granddaughter?

lines.en: Who grabbed on after the puppy?
segs: Who grabbed on after the puppy?

lines.en: Who grabbed on after the cat?
segs: Who grabbed on after the cat?

lines.en: It's Grandpa! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's Grandpa! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: It's Grandma! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's Grandma! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: It's the mouse! Tap the sparkling friend!
segs: It's the mouse! Tap the sparkling friend!

lines.en: Grandpa: "I'm next~"
Grandma: "I'm next~"
The granddaughter: "I'm next~"
The puppy: "I'm next~"
The cat: "I'm next~"
The mouse: "I'm next~"

lines.text: 와! 할아버지, 할머니, 손녀, 강아지, 고양이, 생쥐! 차례를 다 기억했어요.
lines.en: Wow! Grandpa, Grandma, the granddaughter, the puppy, the cat, the mouse! You remembered the whole order.
segs: Wow! Grandpa, Grandma, the granddaughter, the puppy, the cat, the mouse! You remembered the whole order.

lines.text: 순무국을 한 그릇씩 나눠 줘요. 냄비를 톡 눌러요!
lines.en: Let's share the soup, one bowl each. Tap the pot!
segs: Let's share the soup, one bowl each. Tap the pot!

lines.en: Tap the pot for one bowl each!
segs: Tap the pot for one bowl each!

lines.text: 여섯 그릇, 여섯 명! 딱 맞아요.
lines.en: Six bowls for six friends! Just right.
segs: Six bowls for six friends! Just right.

lines.en: They all ate it up together, yum.
segs: They all ate it up together, yum.

ui.작은 힘도 모이면 커다란 힘이 돼요!: Even small strength becomes big strength when we join together!
